property_summary: Rule: Only the contract owner can successfully call transferOwnership(...) — the reference always enforces that transferOwnership reverts (or prevents) when called by non-owner callers, while the mutant allowing anyone to call transferOwnership breaks this by letting a non-owner change owner for some caller addresses.
change_summary: Remove the onlyOwner check entirely, permitting anyone to call transferOwnership and thus changing the resulting owner after calls.
